search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" app="TA-IPMI" [| rest /services/server/info | eval host=splunk_server | fields host] earliest=-3h | stats latest(status) as st | eval value=if(st=="active","Licensed","Unlicensed") | table value

single.option: key beacon within 3h - enter a key on the License page

panel.html: This host is licensed for TA-IPMI. Thanks for supporting BentleyPC development!

panel.title: Commercial use of TA-IPMI requires a paid license (evaluation, personal, lab use free)

search.query: | makeresults | eval buy="Buy License at bentleypc.com/TA-IPMI", terms="License and Terms at bentleypc.com/TA-IPMI/LICENSE.html" | fields buy terms

panel.title: License status (click "Open License Setup page" to paste your key)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" latest=now earliest=-48h | stats latest(_time) as seen, latest(status) as status, latest(message) as note by host | eval last_reported=strftime(seen,"%F %H:%M"), setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" | append [ | makeresults | eval host="this deployment", status="no data yet", note="beacon reports hourly once a key is set", last_reported="n/a", setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" ] | table host status last_reported note setup | sort host
| mstats avg("ipmi.*temp*") as "v**" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value
| mstats avg("ipmi.*fan*") as "v**" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("ipmi.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("ipmi.*volt*","ipmi.*vcore*","ipmi.*vdd*","ipmi.*12v*","ipmi.*3v*","ipmi.*48v*","ipmi.*5v*","ipmi.*bat*","ipmi.*p1_p*") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("ipmi.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("ipmi.*watt*","ipmi.*power*","ipmi.*psu*","ipmi.*input*","ipmi.*output*") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value
| mcatalog values(metric_name) as m where index=metrics metric_name="ipmi.*" | eval count=mvcount(m)
